summary: Reviewed 14 selected items against 5 reserve candidates. No two selected items cover the same event or angle; topical clustering around AI coding agents (Google Agents CLI, Qwen RL paper, ex-Google harness walkthrough, e-ink Claude Code) is acceptable as distinct angles. Three news/analysis items rest on second-hand or datamined claims with no primary-source traceability in-tweet: the ns123abc Anthropic-Amazon repricing report, the M1Astra Fable 5 datamine, and the low-engagement The_Cyber_News PoC attack. These are kept but flagged for source-traceability caution rather than replaced, since no eligible reserve covers the same beat and the underlying stories are individually distinct and topical. Set size (14) sits one above the normal_max of 13; no removal is forced here but downstream trimming of the weakest item is advisable.
